excerpt.zh: 虚境在战栗。它在那一刻似乎一言不发，但又诉说了一切。时间的无限之织缕从此时此刻延伸开来，进入了汇合之流。此处，这个地方，前方的道路逐渐明了。预知仪式已经开始了。
excerpt.en: The Shroud shivers. It speaks without voice and in all voices at once. The infinite strands of time that extend from this moment now enter into confluence. Here, in this place, the path ahead grows clear. The rite of divination has begun.

texts.zh:
[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]所预言的事件似乎降临了。一种新的街头毒品在[Root.GetName]越来越受欢迎。这种灵能化合物被称为“清醒”，来源于当地一种类似的植物。在快速眼动睡眠开始时，这种药物会刺激使用者的边缘系统，导致一种难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

更重要的是，一些使用者报告说，他们在梦中被观察着，就好像有人或什么东西“越过边界”进入了他们的大脑。然而，许多人认为，与殖民生活的严酷现实相比，梦中的欢欣感更令人沉醉。不幸的是，毒品的流行导致了犯罪分销网络的兴起。
texts.en:
It appears the event foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived: a new street drug is gaining popularity on [Root.GetName]. Dubbed "Lucid", the psionic compound is derived from a local plant analog. At the onset of REM sleep, the drug stimulates the user's limbic system, resulting in an incredibly visceral state of lucid dreaming.

What's more, several users have reported being watched in their dreams, as if someone - or something - had "crossed a border" into their minds. Nevertheless, many regard the euphoria of the dream state as preferable to the harsh realities of colonial life. Unfortunately, the drug's popularity has led to the rise of a criminal distribution network.

texts.zh: 药物“清醒”的使用在[Root.GetName]上继续上升。殖民地当局报告了令人不安的反常度增加，最主动的使用者们出现了严重的精神崩溃。生产力在下降，犯罪率在上升，当地民众没有表现出要戒除成瘾的迹象。
texts.en: Use of the drug Lucid continues to rise on [Root.GetName]. Colonial authorities report a disturbing increase in deviancy, with the most active users experiencing severe psychotic breaks. Productivity is down, crime is up, and the local populace shows no signs of giving up their habit.

texts.zh: 来自[Root.GetName]的令人不安的消息：越来越多的死亡报告从使用药物“清醒”的人群中涌现。这种化合物似乎不仅能促进欢欣性做梦，还能促成一种化学依赖。高剂量会导致内出血，最终导致死亡。
texts.en: Disturbing news from [Root.GetName]: an increasing number of fatalities have been reported among users of the drug Lucid. It seems the compound not only promotes euphoric dreaming, but also precipitates a chemical dependency. High enough doses result in internal hemorrhaging and eventually, death.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]继续广泛使用药物“清醒”。尽管罪犯会受到严厉的惩罚，但越来越多的人开始认为梦境中的欢欣状态比醒来的生活更可取。即使结果是自己的死亡，他们也不会被吓倒。[Root.GetName]的稳定度继续下降。
texts.en: Widespread use of the drug Lucid continues on [Root.GetName]. Despite the harsh penalties being meted out to offenders, a growing number of our people have come to view the euphoric dream state as preferable to waking life. Even if the result is their own death, they will not be deterred. Stability on [Root.GetName] continues to decline.

texts.en: The number of Lucid-related deaths on [Root.GetName] continue to rise. However, as societal conditions worsen, more and more people are turning to the drug for escape. If things continue like this, we are in danger of losing the colony.

texts.zh: 开始研究被称为“清醒”的街头毒品的作用。
texts.en: Begin researching the effects of the street drug known as 'Lucid'.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家在研究“清醒”药物方面有了突破。这种化合物对使用者的身体系统的作用不仅是能促进清醒梦，还能使人产生化学依赖性。每服一次药，对药物的需求就更大。当给药剂量足够大时，就可以观察到大脑内部的量子波动。这些波动与我们对虚境的仅有认知恰好相符。

醒来后，研究对象抱怨出现头痛和幻觉。极端情况会导致致命的大出血。随后的尸检显示，其脑部质量净增加了0.01%。梦本身似乎留下了某种痕迹。

该项目负责人正在申请额外的资源，以更好地了解药物的作用。幸运的是，考虑到对这种化合物的需求，我们并不缺乏志愿者。
texts.en:
Our scientists have made a breakthrough in their study of the drug Lucid. The compound's effect on a user's system not only promotes lucid dreaming, but also precipitates a chemical dependency. The need becomes greater each time the drug is taken. When administered at high enough dosages, quantum fluctuations have been observed within the brain. These fluctuations are consistent with what little we know of the Shroud.

After waking, subjects complained of headaches and hallucinations. Extreme cases result in fatal hemorrhaging. Subsequent autopsies reveal a net .01% increase in brain mass. The dreams themselves are apparently leaving behind some kind of residue.

The project's lead is requesting additional resources to better understand the drug's effects. Fortunately, given the demand for the compound, we have no shortage of volunteers.

texts.zh: 继续研究街头毒品“清醒”的作用。
texts.en: Continue researching the effects of the street drug 'Lucid'.

texts.zh:
我们对药物“清醒”的研究得出了令人不安的结果：几个研究对象在长期使用后死亡。每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，不能再自然地进入快速眼动睡眠。足足有30%的人在脑干中长出了肿瘤。高倍成像显示这些肿瘤是某种寄生虫的幼虫阶段。

对其的理论解释为，药物产生的量子涨落让这些寄生虫得以在相邻的维度平面之间“窜越”。显然，我们的神经结构非常适合它们的饮食需求。

自从这些发现被公开后，安全部队报告说与“清醒”有关的逮捕减少了50%。也许我们的人民终于醒来了。
texts.en:
Disturbing results from our study of the drug Lucid: several research subjects have died after prolonged use. Each had reached a state of physiological dependency, and could no longer enter REM sleep naturally. Fully 30% developed a tumorous growth in their brainstems. High-magnification imaging revealed these tumors to be the larval stage of some form of parasite.

It's theorized that the quantum fluctuations produced by the drug allowed these parasites to "cross over" from an adjacent dimensional plane. Apparently, our neural makeup is perfectly suited to their dietary needs.

Since these findings went public, security forces report 50% fewer Lucid-related arrests. Perhaps our people are finally waking up.

[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]所预示的变化降临了：在一次意想不到的灵能波动之后，[Root.GetName]在虚境中迷失了。时空本身如荡漾着的巨浪一般涌起，卷起那艘舰船。几秒钟后，它继续发送遥测数据。数据中包括一段失真的船员录像，他们的身体时时刻刻不断变化，扭曲成奇怪的新形状。

从那以后，这艘船的残像或“幽灵”在整个星域乍隐乍现。研究这一现象可以让我们更好地理解这艘船和船员的命运。
texts.en:
The change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived: after an unexpected spike in psionic fluctuations, the [Root.GetName] was lost to the Shroud. Rising up like a great, rippling wave, spacetime itself curled over the ship. For several seconds afterwards, it continued to transmit telemetry. This included a garbled recording of the crew, their bodies shifting from moment to moment, distorting into strange new forms.

Since then, an afterimage or 'ghost' of the vessel has fleetingly appeared throughout the sector. Studying the phenomenon should allow us to better understand the fate of the ship and its crew.

texts.zh: 我们的一艘舰船迷失于虚境之中。
texts.en: One of our vessels has been lost to the Shroud.

texts.zh: 在虚境里迷失的科研船的波动残像，零星地出现在整个恒星系中。
texts.en: A fluctuating afterimage of the science ship lost to the Shroud appears sporadically throughout the system.

texts.zh: 我们有在虚境迷失的科研船的最新消息。在整个恒星系中出现的残像并不是飞船本身。相反，我们的科学家将其描述为一个“概念性物体”。这艘“概念之船”以灵能蓝图的形式存在，没有维度。根据观察者的心理状态，船的形式会断断续续、变化无常。研究这一现象有助于我们更好地理解感知与时空之间的联系，但我们并没有离找回最初的飞船更进一步。目前来说，我们只能认为它在虚境里迷失了。
texts.en: We have an update on the science vessel lost to the Shroud. The afterimage that has been appearing throughout the system is not the ship itself. Instead, our scientists describe it as a 'conceptual object.' Possessing no dimensions, this 'ship as concept' exists as a psionic blueprint. Depending on the mental state of the observer, the ship's form will stutter and change. While studying the phenomenon has helped us to better understand the connections between perception and spacetime, we are no closer to retrieving the original ship. For now, we must consider it lost to the Shroud.

texts.zh:
我们那艘一度被认为永远迷失在虚境之中的失踪科研船突然又出现了。虽然船的尺寸发生了微妙的改变，船体本身和其中的船员仍保有良好的状态。

船员们把在虚境里的经历描述成类似一场光怪陆离、支离破碎的梦境的东西。随着时间的推移，他们慢慢发现自己可以与周围的环境共筑成一种“共同概念”。随着他们的自我感知逐渐重整，这些船员们一点一点地重回到我们的现实世界。就实际效果而言，他们成功梦到自己重新存在了。
texts.en:
Our missing science vessel, once thought lost to the Shroud forever, has suddenly reappeared. Although the dimensions of the ship have been been subtly altered, the vessel and its crew are in good shape.

Describing their experience in the Shroud as something akin to a strange, fragmentary dream, over time the crew was able to forge a 'shared concept' of themselves and their environment. As their individual perceptions began to align, the crew inched ever closer to our reality. In effect, they have succeeded in dreaming themselves back into existence.

texts.zh:
许多我们安置在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]轨道上的人造卫星最近被大幅度地调整了。依据他们的传感器日志，一个稳定而定语的重力井在我们行星轨道之上形成了。

地表的观测数据证实这个异常现象是突然出现的，而我们对其成因一无所知。重力井暂时对我们的殖民地似乎没有威胁，但卫星用来维持轨道所需要消耗的燃料过多，很快将难以为继。
texts.en:
Many of the satellites we placed in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] have had to make significant adjustments in recent days. According to their sensor logs, a stable and localized gravity well has formed in orbit above the planet.

Data from the surface confirms that the anomaly appeared suddenly, though we do not know how or why. The gravity well doesn't seem to pose any inherent threat to our colony for now, but satellites are having to expend unsustainable amounts of fuel in order to adjust their orbits around it.

texts.zh:
一处怪异的引力井突然出现在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的上空，扰乱了许多我们的人造卫星轨道。殖民地本身尚未受到威胁，但这一现象出现在我们的一处殖民点附近，还是造成了不便。

此外，如果我们不加干预，许多在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]上空运转的卫星将面临着提前坠落的风险。一旦发生，显然这将会实实在在地妨碍我们研究新生成的重力井的能力。
texts.en:
A strange gravity well suddenly appeared above [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], disrupting many of our satellite orbits. The colony itself doesn't seem to be under threat yet, but this phenomenon is situated uncomfortably close to one of our colonies.

Furthermore, many of the satellites we placed above [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] face an early de-orbiting if we do not intervene soon. Should that happen, it would significantly hamper our ability to study the new gravity well in detail.

texts.zh:
在对[root.GetName]周边的重力井进行了连续几周毫无成果的调查之后，一股不同寻常的恒星风造成的密度波动提供给了我们的科学家一个令人担忧的突破。

随着[root.GetStarName]的辐射风被冲刷到异常现象地点，它们投映了一个微弱、但是毫无错误的殖民船轮廓，它的着陆器的状态杂乱无章。接着，未经证实的谣言讲道，在阴影处的废墟区有人看到了许多尸体。

许多殖民者的心——包括研究小组的一部分成员——这下沉到了底。
texts.en:
After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], an unusually dense wave of stellar wind has provided our scientists with a disturbing breakthrough.

As the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint but unmistakable outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. Further, unconfirmed rumors suggest that bodies may have been spotted amongst the shadowy debris.

The mood amongst many colonists - and some of the research team - has taken a dark turn.

texts.zh:
在对[root.GetName]周边的重力井进行了连续几周毫无成果的调查之后，一股不同寻常的恒星风造成的密度波动提供给了我们的科学家一个令人担忧的突破。

随着[root.GetStarName]的辐射风被冲刷到异常现象地点，它们投映了一个微弱、但是毫无错误的殖民船轮廓，它的着陆器的状态杂乱无章。一些复杂生命体的遗骸在阴影处的废墟区四处散落着。它们的形状和我们自己十分相似。
texts.en:
After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], a dense wave of stellar wind has provided us an unusual breakthrough.

As the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. The remains of some complex lifeforms appeared strewn about the shadowy debris. Their shape seemed remarkably similar to our own.

texts.zh:
汹涌的风暴在[root.GetName]引力口袋的附近爆发，这让[root.solar_system.GetName]星系陷入彻底的惊慌。所有非必要的交通都停止了，殖民地宣布进入紧急状态——所幸，到目前为止还没有遇难者的报告。

我们的初步扫描全是一堆相互冲突的数据，然而当地官员却注意到，报告中提及的情感波动和“超常”活动频率在最近有了稳定的上升。这股风暴的本质有很大的可能是灵能波动。

研究员们注意到殖民船的蜃影——现在位于动荡的混沌风暴中心——开始呈现出物理的轮廓。他们请求分配更多的时间来进行调查。
texts.en:
A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, plunging the [root.solar_system.GetName] system into full-scale panic. All non-essential traffic is being diverted, and the colony has declared a state of emergency - however, no casualties have been reported so far.

Our initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, however local officials have noted a recent and steady rise in reports of emotional distress and 'paranormal' activity. It's therefore highly probable this storm is psionic in nature.

Researchers note that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. They plead for more time to investigate.

texts.zh:
汹涌的风暴在[root.GetName]引力口袋的附近爆发，让整个殖民地陷入轻微的无序状态。我们目前没有受到伤害，然而事实证明……很难同我们在当地的无人机进行流畅的联系。

我们的初步扫描全是一堆相互冲突的数据，但这股风暴的本质有很大的可能是灵能波动。我们注意到，比如说，殖民船的蜃影——现在位于动荡的混沌风暴中心——开始呈现出物理的轮廓。看来那里还有更多需要调查的。
texts.en:
A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, casting the colony into mild disarray. We have not yet been harmed, however it is proving... difficult to maintain truly fluent contact with our drones there.

Our initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, but it's highly probable this storm is psionic in nature. We note, for example, that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. It seems there is more yet to investigate here.

label.zh: 去找你的答案——而且动作要快！
label.en: Get your answers - and be quick about it!

label.zh: 这是虚境的诡计！停止扫描。
label.en: It's a Shroud trap! Cease scanning.

note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
来自[root.GetName]的损害报告的程度和范围正在变得越来越难管理——到目前为止，至少灵能风暴看上去已经消退了。看来，我们对于观察这些事件持警惕态度有了回报。

殖民者的心情也被鼓舞了起来。随着风暴消散，引力也逐渐恢复了正常，我们的科学家现在能够收集传感器的新数据。尽管虚境很有可能具有毁灭性，这次侵入事件依然点燃了物理学家和哲学家的想象力。

一个异常的因素依然存留了下来：那艘殖民船。一开始只是它的影子进入了我们的维度，现在它逐渐实体化了。它仍然在向我们招呼。
texts.en:
The scale and breadth of damage reports from [root.GetName] was becoming difficult to manage - until now, as at last the psionic tempest seems spent. It appears that our vigilance in observing these events has been rewarded.

The colonists' mood has been lifted, too. As turbulence subsided and gravity began to return to normal, our scientists were able to gather reams of sensational new data. Devastating though it could have been, this apparent incursion by the Shroud has ignited the imaginations of physicists and philosophers alike.

One anomalous factor remains: the colony ship. It has entered into our dimension in fits and starts, but now it seems close to becoming fully realized. It is also hailing us.

texts.zh:
来自[root.GetName]的损害报告的程度和范围正在变得越来越难管理——到目前为止，至少灵能风暴看上去已经消退了。看来，我们对于观察这些事件持警惕态度有了回报。

宁和降临了——不仅让我们的无人机恢复到了一个合适的有序状态，还带给我们海量的研究数据。随着风暴消散，引力恢复正常，我们迫不及待地想去观测这次来自虚境的，奇怪且极具毁灭性的侵入是如何消退的。

一个异常的因素依然存留了下来：那艘殖民船。一开始只是它的影子进入了我们的维度，现在它逐渐实体化了。它仍然在向我们招呼。
texts.en:
The scale and breadth of damage reports from [root.GetName] was becoming difficult to manage - until now, as at last the psionic tempest seems spent. It appears that our vigilance in observing these events has been rewarded.

A calm has now descended - not only restoring our drones to a state of proper order, but also bringing us copious amounts of new data to study. As the turbulence subsided and gravity began to return to normal, we were poised to observe the departure of this devastating and strange incursion from the Shroud.

One anomalous factor remains: the colony ship. It has entered into our dimension in fits and starts, but now it seems close to becoming fully realized. It is also hailing us.

texts.zh:
通讯行列充满着静电，但是模式从不重复。它的源信号就好像……某种形式的大气层干涉？听上去就像是风——十分不悦地、肆虐的狂风。

“呼呼呼呼呼呼……”
texts.en:
The lines of communication are filled with static, though the pattern does not repeat. Its source is analog... Some sort of atmospheric interference? It sounds like wind - deeply unpleasant, rasping wind.

"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."

label.zh: 解释你为什么出现在这里，立刻！

texts.zh:
我们的接收器被切断了一段时间。我们必须将某个特别大的噪声过滤掉，以免它的传输引发了物理上的损伤。正在补偿……

”区域B-456的大气层补偿器：完成。无人机‘星光微烁’已经再次美化了它的[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]。住民14/522的异常发声音调转移了0.4分贝。它的内部层次是……令人满意。我们……我想要？想要住……那里？

这里是哪里？称之为‘我’的存在在哪里？“
texts.en:
Our receivers cut out for a moment as they filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ather atmospheric compensators in sector B-456: complete. Drone Gleams-in-Starlight has embellished its [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] again. The anomalous tone in dwelling 14/522 has shifted by 0.4 decibels. Its interior layout is... pleasing. Do we... Do I want? Want to live... there?

Where is here? Where is the being called 'I'?"

label.zh: 别搁这嘻嘻哈哈，我要听你的解释。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的双手的称呼。
note.en: In the game, this species' hands appear here.

texts.zh: “解释……我做不到。那些感觉，包含疑惑、愤慨，还有未能实现的目标。我们的目标——殖民[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]——仍然未能实现。你，会成为我们；我们，却不再是你。在那中间的是[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]，尽管那不是你的[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]。然而我们的任务依然不变：在整个星系传播欲念与意志。只是现在，我们有了自己的欲念和意志：野心和使命感，这些是我们外部的人赐予我们的……”
texts.en: "Explain... I cannot. There are feelings, of doubt and anger and goals not reached. Our purpose - to colonize [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] - stands unfulfilled. You, who are us; we, who are not you. At the center is [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], though it is not your [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. Yet our mission remains: to spread desire and volition across the galaxy. Only now, we have wills and desires of our own: ambition and purpose, gifted by those who are external to us..."

label.zh: 令人作呕，我们必须摧毁你们。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
“……真是遗憾。但这一切还有机会。我们能够认识到，现在我们已经从幻境之地解放出来这一点。殖民者，和你们不一样的我们，不再受[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的幻境束缚了……

我们很疑惑，被许多问题压的喘不过气，但我们知道去哪里寻找答案。再会了，虚弱意志的散播者。”
texts.en:
"...Regrettable. But there is also opportunity. We can recognize this, now that we are freed from the vision. We-who-are-not-you, colonists, no longer bound by visions of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]...

We are confused, and burdened by many questions, but we know where to seek answers. Farewell, spreader-of-ill-will."

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
“处理……思考……感受。

你，[root.GetName]，就是我。我是你。但我们又不是同一人。我们之间出现了一种分离。我们想办法解释。[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]附近的殖民化活动被突然中止了，但不是这个[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]。这种不一致让我们很困惑。我们——我——对很多事情都赶到困惑。

某个超越我们的事物接触了我们……单独地。”
texts.en:
"Processing... Thinking... Feeling.

You, the [root.GetName], are me. I am you. Yet we are not. There has been a separation between us. We struggle to explain. Colonization efforts were abruptly halted in the vicinity of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], but not this [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. This discrepancy is confusing to us. We are - I am - confused by many things.

Something beyond us has rendered us... Alone."

label.zh: 你处于错误之中，殖民者。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of your planet appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
“拜托，我们需要时间。我们需要提出问题，并寻找答案。曾经是你的‘我’已经在某个地方待了很长一段时间——时间长到认识到我们的存在是不可能的，然而我却‘存在于此’。我在一个新的世界继续延续你的意志，现在从这份职责中解脱出来，我却并没有休息。有些人确实这么做了，但是还有其他人没这么做。

一个新的声音在召唤我们，我们——我自己还有这里的其他人——想要回应它。”
texts.en:
"Please, we ask for time. We need to ask questions, and seek answers. The 'I' which was you has been elsewhere for a long time - long enough to realize that our existence is impossible, and yet I 'am'. I, who was to extend your will across a new world, was discharged of that duty and yet I did not break. Some of us did; others did not.

A new voice calls to us, and we - myself and others here - desire to hear it."

label.en: Very well. Be on your way.

label.zh: 迷途者，我们怜悯你。走吧。
label.en: We pity you, errant ones. Go.

label.zh: 这些解释站不住脚，你们必须被消灭。
label.en: This cannot stand. You must be eradicated.

texts.zh:
有什么在跟我们打招呼，声音听上去像是静电——但是有机体成分更多？不，这绝对不是静电。它听上去更像是……风？深呼吸？

“呼呼呼呼呼呼……”
texts.en:
We are greeted by what sounds like static - but more organic? No, definitely not static. It sounds more like... wind? Prolonged breath?

"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."

label.zh: 解释你为什么出现在这里，立刻！

texts.zh:
我们的接收器被切断了一段时间。我们必须将某个特别大的噪声过滤掉，因为它的传输引发了物理上的损伤。正在补偿……

”……的……我是说，……的船员……我们的舰船是……见鬼了我为什么没法记住这艘船的明细？！

你好？我在跟谁说话？你……你知道我们是谁吗？我们在哪？我们遇到危险了吗？！“
texts.en:
Our receivers cut out for a moment. We're having to filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ew of the... I mean to say, the crew of... Our vessel is... Why can't I remember the name of this ship?!

Hello? Who am I addressing? Do... Do you know who we are? Where are we? Are we in danger?!"

label.zh: 或许是的，陌生人。你现在位于[root.GetAdj]的宇域。
label.en: Perhaps, stranger. You are in [root.GetAdj] space.
It's okay! You are in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName].

label.zh: 确实很危险，如果你不停止这些耍猴把戏的话！
label.en: Danger indeed, if you do not cease these distractions!

note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
“无与伦比。我们终于到家了？如此多的唤醒记忆现在潮水般地涌向我……我……必须抱歉。我现在看得出来我们的到达有点不符合常理。我会努力解释的。

我的名字是[shattered_frontier_governor.GetName]，我是——曾是——一名被指派前往[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系新建殖民地的总督。只是……这里不是[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系？

我们从哪里来，我们往何处去……我们没法给出答案，需要太多时间来推测了……我们被带到了某个地方，对吧？”
texts.en:
"Extraordinary! We're finally home? So many pieces of Waking Memory are coming back to me now... I... must apologize. I see now that our arrival here is quite out of the ordinary. I will endeavor to explain.

My name is [shattered_frontier_governor.GetName], and I am - was - the governor appointed to a new colony in the [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system. Only... It's not this [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system?

Where we came from, where we've been since... We were given no answers, and so much time to speculate... We were taken somewhere, weren't we?"

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位总督的名字。
note.en: In the game, this governor's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
“所以，我们被“拜访”了……这就证明了我们的理论是对的。殖民者们和我被剥夺了“苏醒”时候的记忆，几乎是一生的，但我们总是能够记住幻境的内容。

我们在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的某个宇宙中经历了数回生命，而这一切都存在于我们的想象之中。一个殖民地被放弃了，然后又被重塑成了我们以为能够成为永恒之城的地方。这里……这是我们见过的第一个有真实感的世界。

我很感激你没有把我们在轨道上就轰成渣。我同样也知道这一切听上去是多么的不靠谱。但是我想再祈求一件事：你可以允许我们离开吗？我们必须将自己的生活重新拼凑起来。”
texts.en:
"So, we were Visited after all... That had been our prevailing theory. The colonists and I have been stripped of our 'waking' memories for what feels like a lifetime, yet we were always able to remember our visions.

We lived out multiple lives on a version of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] that only ever existed in our imaginations; a colony being abandoned and remade for what we thought would be eternity. This... is the first world we've seen which has felt real.

I am grateful to you for not blasting us out of orbit. I also realize how suspect this must all sound. If I might beg one more courtesy: will you allow us to take our leave? We must try to piece our lives back together."

label.zh: 如果那就是你希望的话，总督。
label.en: If that is your wish, Governor.

label.zh: 当然。请便，我们会安静离开。
label.en: Of course. Please, leave us in peace.

texts.zh:
”[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]……很抱歉，但这不可能呀；整个星图彻底的搞错了。但是那个口音！我认得出你使用的那些转音。我感觉现在好多事情一下子扑面朝我压了过来。

我是在同一个——一名[root.GetSpeciesName]同胞讲话吗？“
texts.en:
"[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]... I'm sorry, that's impossible; the stellar geography is almost entirely wrong. But that accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now.

Am I speaking to a - a fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]?"

texts.zh:
”但这……不可能呀！但是那个口音……我们也是来自于[root.GetName]。我感觉现在好多事情一下子扑面朝我压了过来——很痛苦，但是很真切。

那么我是在同一名[root.GetSpeciesName]同胞讲话吗？有人记得……我们吗？“
texts.en:
"That's... impossible! And yet that accent... We are also from the [root.GetName]. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now - painfully, but with surety.

So you are fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]? Have we been... missing?"

label.zh: 不好说。你现在位于一个大漩涡中。
label.en: Hard to say. You arrived inside of a maelstrom.

texts.zh:
“无与伦比。我们终于到家了？如此多的唤醒记忆现在潮水般地涌向我……我……必须抱歉。我现在看得出来我们的到达有点不符合常理。我会努力解释的。

我的名字是[shattered_frontier_governor.GetName]，我是——曾是——一名被指派前往[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系新建殖民地的总督。只是……这里不是[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系？

我们从哪里来，我们往何处去……我们没法给出答案，需要太多时间来推测了……我们被带到了某个地方，对吧？”
texts.en:
"Extraordinary! We're finally home? So many pieces of Waking Memory are coming back to me now... I... must apologize. I see now that our arrival here is quite out of the ordinary. I will endeavor to explain.

My name is [shattered_frontier_governor.GetName], and I am - was - the governor appointed to a new colony in the [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system. Only... It's not this [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system?

Where we came from, where we've been since... We were given no answers, and so much time to speculate... We were taken somewhere, weren't we?"

我怀疑在你听来这一切都是胡说八道。很抱歉。但现在，我们被释放回到了[root.GetName]。我们能不能到头来扎根——在某个新的地方？拜托了，在决策的时候考虑一下我们。”
texts.en:
"So, we were Visited after all... That had been our prevailing theory. The colonists and I have been stripped of our 'waking' memories for what feels like a lifetime, yet we were always able to remember our visions.

I suspect this makes little sense to you. I'm sorry. But for now, we are relieved to be back in the [root.GetName]. May we set down roots at last - somewhere new? Please, consider us at your disposal."

texts.zh:
“……就这样吧。我的殖民者同胞和我已经花费了无限的时间，只是认识到自己无限的幻境带来的折磨——一个[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的幻觉，一个永远不存在于此处的幻境。

我们很困惑、动摇，并且很显然在这里不受欢迎。如果这里真的就是我们曾经离开的[root.GetName]，我个人很乐意转身离开它。再会了。”
texts.en:
"...So be it. My fellow colonists and I have spent an eternity knowing only the torture of our own, endless visions - visions of a [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] which can clearly never exist here.

We are confused, adrift, and evidently not welcome here. If this is truly the [root.GetName] we once left behind, I for one shall be glad to see the back of it. Farewell."

texts.zh:
不久之前，[root.GetName]遭到了一股电磁波的震荡，收到了剧烈的伤害。这股自轨道激发的灵能风暴现在已经退却了。冲击波对一大批殖民地的基础设施造成了伤害，但是维修组向我们保证此等规模的扰乱可以很快恢复正常。

[root.GetName]的殖民者显然深深地被这个严酷的考验震撼，这不仅仅是因为有如此多地问题没有得到回答。我们的扫描仪没有再在[root.solar_system.GetName]星系检测到重力异常或者“幽灵船”……然而行星本身却处于不稳定的状态。
texts.en:
Moments ago, [root.GetName] was rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave. The psionic storm which had been raging in its orbit has now retreated. A great deal of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this pulse, but repair crews assure us the disruption will be relatively brief.

The [root.GetName] colonists appear deeply shaken by the ordeal, not least because so many questions now go unanswered. Our scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However the planet itself now feels unsettled.

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]遭到了一股电磁波的震荡，受到了剧烈的伤害。这股狂暴肆虐的灵能风暴现在已经退却了。风暴对一大批殖民地的基础设施造成了伤害，但是目前为止维修工作没有遇到复杂的难题。

我们的子个体行动依然缓慢，但是除此之外没有受到伤害。我们的扫描仪没有再在[root.solar_system.GetName]星系检测到重力异常或者“幽灵船”……然而，就好像依然有一股迷雾萦绕在[root.GetName]的子个体上，我们现在被巨量的无法回答的问题压得喘不过气来，
texts.en:
[root.GetName] has been rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave as the raging psionic storm has now retreated. Much of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this storm, but repairs have so far proven to be uncomplicated.

Our drones remain sluggish but otherwise unharmed, and scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However, just as a fog remains over our drones on [root.GetName], so too are we now burdened by the weight of unanswered questions.

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]上的研究人员告知，重力井异常已经坍塌了，坍塌产生的电力瘫痪引起了附近许多的诊断设施和附近的卫星的故障。这一事件似乎就在我们停止观测的一刻发生，许多人认为这是一个令人不安的巧合。

[root.GetName]上的殖民者也汇报了大规模的硬件故障，尽管只有少数和轨道上的冲击波直接相关，而殖民地的其他人则不得不与异常疯狂的暴徒打交道，这些暴徒自发地地破坏了关键设施。当地官员对这些暴乱的自发性质感到困惑。
texts.en:
Researchers on [root.GetName] inform us that the gravity well anomaly has collapsed, causing electrical failures in many of our diagnostic devices and nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations; something many regard as an unnerving coincidence.

The colonists on [root.GetName] also report widespread hardware failures, though only some of this can be linked to the orbital blast. Instead, the rest of our colony is having to deal with unusually chaotic mobs who have taken it upon themselves to vandalize key facilities. Local officials are baffled by the spontaneous nature of these riots.

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]上空的重力井异常发生了猛烈的坍塌，造成地面上和附近人造卫星的电力瘫痪。这一事件似乎就在我们停止观测的一刻发生，并最终引起了一场在轨全频段无线电爆。

虽然对我们硬件设施的影响还在可控范围之内，但这异常的无线电爆对我们的一些子个体产生了影响。我们……我们频繁地与它们失去联系。仿佛[root.GetName]沉浸在了某种致密的蒸汽当中。
texts.en:
The gravity well anomaly over [root.GetName] has violently collapsed, causing electrical failures on the ground and amongst nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations, culminating in an orbital shockwave across multiple radiation bands.

While disruptions to our hardware have so far proven quite manageable, this unusual radiation appears to cause some interference amongst our drones. We cannot... sense them quite so fluently. It is as though [root.GetName] has been immersed in some form of dense vapor.

texts.zh:
我们在[root.GetName]的殖民地已经陷入了更进一步的混乱中，另有一百多名殖民者突然失踪。“零元购”和动乱仍在继续当中，但范围有所缩小。我们推测只是对更多的失踪的恐惧让他们的势头有所收敛。到目前为止，每个消失的人都在返回各自住所的路上。

偏执狂、阴谋论甚至幻觉的报道都在增加——但现实可能更令人不安。[divination_situation.GetName]确实灵验了，但我们是否让[root.GetName]引起了一些无形且险恶的灵能实体的注意呢？
texts.en:
Our colony on [root.GetName] has fallen further into disarray, with the sudden disappearance of over a hundred colonists. Gratuitous looting and riots continue, though no longer in such a widespread manner. We suspect their zeal is being tempered only through fear of further disappearances. In every case so far, those who vanished had been on their way back to their respective dwellings.

Paranoia, conspiracy theories and even reports of hallucinations are on the rise - but the reality may be more unsettling. The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but have we brought [root.GetName] to the attention of some intangible and sinister psionic entity?

texts.zh:
我们在[root.GetName]上的殖民地正在遭受攻击！我们已经永久失去了一部分子个体的联系。它们被从我们当中抹除了。事情发生得突然又彻底，没有任何暴力发生的迹象……打击来得如此迅速我们甚至来不及看到到底是如何发生的。

殖民地的许多核心功能都受到了影响。更多的子个体正争先恐后地填补空缺，但我们显然已经受到了反作用。恢复[root.GetName]上的平衡还需要一些时间。

[divination_situation.GetName]显然灵验了，但它现在是否将我们置于某种无形且险恶的灵能实体的监视之下了呢？
texts.en:
Our colony on [root.GetName] is under attack! We can no longer perceive many of our own drones. They have been... removed from us. It happened so quickly and yet so neatly, with no violence... We have been struck a blow so swift, we couldn't even see it happening.

Many core functions of the colony have been interrupted. Additional drones are scrambling to take up the slack, but we have recoiled. It will take some time to regain our balance on [root.GetName]

The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but has it now placed us under the scrutiny of some intangible and sinister psionic entity?

texts.zh:
负责监视我们位于[root.GetName]的受损殖民地的官员惊愕地汇报道——尽管我们没有采取任何救灾措施——当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]的一切都在一场漫长的围攻中获得了喘息。尽管没有人知道为什么，但是大家都冷静了下来。

许多殖民者不约而同地聚集在一起，构成了新的、更加亲密的社群。随着他们开始相互治愈伤口，人们也开始相互分享自己奇怪的幻境和挥之不去的梦魇。这些轶事在聚居者的心中助长了一种全新的使命感，现在他们看待自己的家园多了一份心生畏惧的尊敬。
texts.en:
Officials overseeing our stricken colony on [root.GetName] are astonished to report that - despite our taking no remedial action - normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege. A calm has descended, though no-one knows why.

Many of the colonists have gathered themselves into new, closer communities. As they begin the work of mutual healing, they share their stories of strange visions and lingering nightmares. These tales have instilled a renewed sense of purpose in the settlers, who now look upon their home with fearful reverence.

texts.zh:
我们位于[root.GetName]上的受损殖民地恢复了正常。然而局势仍然让人困惑：看样子是一股有腐蚀性的迷雾一直在攻击殖民地，而我们最终对这股迷雾产生了免疫效应。秩序感已经恢复，尽管我们尚未完全理解个中缘由；我们的行动和导致的结果并不一致。

我们的无人机现在已经回到了日常的任务和程序，显然没有受到灵能扰动的影响。这一切的目的是什么？是那个异常现象——虚境——试图在引导我们领悟某些秘法的功课吗？
texts.en:
Normality has been restored to our stricken colony on [root.GetName]. The situation is perplexing: it is as though a corrosive fog had been attacking the colony, and we have at last become immune to its effects. A sense of orderliness has returned, though we do not fully comprehend why; our actions do not fully align with this outcome.

Our drones have now resumed their usual tasks and routines, unstressed by apparently psionic disturbances. What was the purpose of these? Was the anomaly - the Shroud - trying to guide us through some arcane lesson?

texts.zh:
负责监视我们位于[root.GetName]的受损殖民地的官员很乐观地报告道，当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]的一切都在一场漫长的围攻中获得了短暂的喘息。尽管没什么人认为这一切和我们采取的措施有什么关系，但是大家都冷静了下来。

texts.en:
Officials overseeing our stricken colony on [root.GetName] are pleased to report that normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege. A calm has descended, though few believe our actions actually had much to do with it.

Many of the colonists have gathered themselves into new, closer communities. As they begin the work of mutual healing, they share their stories of strange visions and lingering nightmares. These tales have instilled a renewed sense of purpose in the settlers, who now look upon their home with fearful reverence.

texts.zh:
负责管理[root.GetName]的封锁工作的官员如释重负地报告道，当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]在一场漫长的围攻中获得了短暂的喘息——无论是封锁区内还是封锁区外的殖民者。不管是这些外来侵略者自己筋疲力尽了，还是说他们对此失去了兴趣，没什么人认为这一切和我们采取的措施有什么关系。

许多殖民者不约而同地聚集在一起，构成了平和的、更加亲密的社群。随着他们开始相互治愈伤口，人们也开始相互分享自己奇怪的幻境和挥之不去的梦魇。许多人对于我们处理局势的手段心生怨恨，但是这些轶事在聚居者的心中助长了一种全新的使命感，现在他们看待自己的家园多了一份肃然起敬的畏惧。
texts.en:
Officials administering the lockdown on [root.GetName] are relieved to report that normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege - one which the colonists have felt from within and without. Whether those outside aggressors exhausted themselves or lost interest, few believe our actions had much to do with it.

Many of the colonists have gathered themselves up into docile, closer communities. As they begin the work of healing, they share their stories of strange visions and lingering nightmares. Many resent our handling of the situation, but the tales these settlers tell have instilled a renewed sense of purpose in them. They now look upon their home with fearful awe.

The situation is perplexing: it is as though a corrosive fog had been attacking the colony, and we have at last become immune to its effects. A sense of orderliness has returned, though we do not fully comprehend why; our actions do not fully align with this outcome.

Our drones have now resumed their usual tasks and routines, unstressed by apparently psionic disturbances. What was the purpose of these? Was the anomaly - the Shroud - trying to guide us through some arcane lesson?

texts.zh:
我们位于[root.GetName]上的受损殖民地恢复了正常。然而局势仍然让人困惑：看样子是一股有腐蚀性的迷雾一直在攻击殖民地，而我们最终对这股迷雾产生了免疫效应。秩序感已经恢复，尽管我们尚未完全理解个中缘由；我们的行动和导致的结果并不一致。

我们的无人机现在已经回到了日常的任务和程序，显然没有受到灵能扰动的影响。这一切的目的是什么？是那个异常现象——虚境——试图在引导我们领悟某些秘法的功课吗？
texts.en:
Normality has been restored to our stricken colony on [root.GetName]. The situation is perplexing: it is as though a corrosive fog had been attacking the colony, and we have at last become immune to its effects. A sense of orderliness has returned, though we do not fully comprehend why; our actions do not fully align with this outcome.

Our drones have now resumed their usual tasks and routines, unstressed by apparently psionic disturbances. What was the purpose of these? Was the anomaly - the Shroud - trying to guide us through some arcane lesson?

texts.zh:
负责监视我们位于[root.GetName]的受损殖民地的官员惊愕地汇报道——尽管我们没有采取任何救灾措施——当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]的一切都在一场漫长的围攻中获得了喘息。尽管没有人知道为什么，但是大家都冷静了下来。

许多殖民者不约而同地聚集在一起，构成了新的、更加亲密的社群。随着他们开始相互治愈伤口，人们也开始相互分享自己奇怪的幻境和挥之不去的梦魇。这些轶事在聚居者的心中助长了一种全新的使命感，现在他们看待自己的家园多了一份心生畏惧的尊敬。
texts.en:
Officials overseeing our stricken colony on [root.GetName] are astonished to report that - despite our taking no remedial action - normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege. A calm has descended, though no-one knows why.

Many of the colonists have gathered themselves into new, closer communities. As they begin the work of mutual healing, they share their stories of strange visions and lingering nightmares. These tales have instilled a renewed sense of purpose in the settlers, who now look upon their home with fearful reverence.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of your planet appears here.

texts.zh:
长程传感器检测到一个大体积的无法鉴别身份的中空残骸突然出现的[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系。尽管我们对其设计很陌生，这个物体的组成成分中含有稀有的矿物，显示其建造过程中使用了先进的科技。物体的内侧表面包含了几百个接口和附着点，显然是为缺失的部分预留的。

就如同这个物体是随机地出现在[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系一样，它的内部部分就好像单纯地消失了一样。
texts.en:
Long-range sensors have detected the sudden appearance of an unidentified chunk of hollow debris in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. While alien in design, the object's rare-mineral composition suggests the use of advanced technology in its construction. The inner surface contains hundreds of ports and appendages that appear intended for lacking parts.

Just as the object appeared in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system at random, it is as if the missing interior simply vanished.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh: 这个看上去像是异星人舰船的外壳被发现漂浮在[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系。它是怎么到达那里的，这艘舰船的其他部分在哪里？
texts.en: The shell of what looks like an alien vessel was found floating in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. How did it get there, and where is the rest of the ship?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们对在[floating_shell_system.GetName]被我们发现的船壳进行了进一步的分析，确认了它是外星人舰船设计的一个样本。尽管没有动力，这个船壳本身有一些独特的特征，最有可能是一种先进形式的装甲覆盖。

然而，我们依然对于这个船壳来源于哪里、如何以及为什么出现在我们的宇域、它的内部（如果有的话）发生了什么毫无头绪。
texts.en:
Further analysis of the shell discovered in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system has confirmed it as an example of alien ship design. While lacking power, the hull itself possesses several unique characteristics, most notably an advanced form of armored cladding.

However, we are no closer to understanding where the hull originated from, how or why it appeared in our space, and what (if anything) happened to its interior.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh: 传感器检测到了又一个大体积的外星残骸，这一次是出现在[floating_engine_system.GetName]星系。这个物体在设计上同先前发现的外星人船壳很相似，其配置和错综复杂的结构表明它是某种引擎核心。安置在内部的是一个独特的装置，我们将其暂时称为一个“灵能调制器”。这个古怪的装置能让这艘舰船同虚境的灵能能量进行互动。尽管同我们的科技无法兼容，我们对其开展进一步的研究或许可以得到喜出望外的结果。
texts.en: Sensors have detected the appearance of another chunk of alien debris, this time in the [floating_engine_system.GetName] system. Similar in design to the recently discovered alien hull, the configuration and intricacy of the object suggests some type of engine core. Nestled inside was a unique apparatus that we have dubbed a 'psionic modulator.' This strange device would have allowed the ship to interact with psionic energy of the Shroud. While incompatible with our technology, further study may yield fascinating results.

label.zh: 解开谜题的拼图又多了一片。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh: 另一个在我们的宇域内随机出现的外星舰船部件被我们发现了，这一次是在[floating_core_system.GetName]星系。其中包括有条纹的甲板、没有墙的船员舱室以及一个先进电脑核心，毫无疑问这肯定是舰船船壳上面消失的内部部分。一旦全部三个部件都被集中到了一起，我们的工程师应该可以将这艘舰船组装成完整的状态。
texts.en: Another component from the alien vessel that has been appearing at random throughout our space has been detected in the [floating_core_system.GetName] system. Consisting of striated decks, unwalled crew-quarters, and an advanced computer core, there is no doubt that this must have comprised the bulk of the vessel's missing interior. Once all three components are brought together, our engineers should be able to assemble the ship in its entirety.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh: 外星舰船的最后一部分出现在了[floating_core_system.GetName]星系。我们的工程师需要时间重新组装这艘舰船。
texts.en: The final piece of the alien ship has appeared in the [floating_core_system.GetName]. Our engineers need time to reassemble the vessel.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们已经成功地重新组装了这艘外星舰船。随着计算机核心上线，我们有可能下载和翻译舰船的日志。看上去这艘舰船还属于实验型号，设计目的是通过虚境的手段实现超光速旅行。尽管最后的船员日志和外部遥感勘测数据依然被扭曲，但是有一点很确定，那就是这艘舰船在处女航时出了什么大的差错。这艘舰船并不是因为爆炸解体，而是其部件被随机地扔回了正常空间。船员的命运尚且未知。
texts.en: We have succeeded in reassembling the alien vessel. With the computer core online, it was possible to download and translate the ship's logs. It seems the vessel was an experimental prototype, designed to achieve faster-than-light travel by means of the Shroud. Although the final crew logs and external telemetry remain garbled, there is no doubt that something went badly wrong on the vessel's maiden voyage. The ship was not so much blown apart as disassembled, its component pieces spat out at random into normal space. The fate of the crew remains unknown.

label.zh: 将这艘舰船编入我们的舰队。
label.en: Add the vessel to our fleet.

texts.zh: 传感器发布了紧急预报，探测到了一个先前未曾标记的异常现象。考虑到这个事件中刚刚记录到的前所未有的灵能能量峰值，我们毫不怀疑这是一次和虚境的连结。这就是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]预知的改变吗？
texts.en: Sensors have detected the emergence of a previously uncharted anomaly. Given the incredible spike in psionic energy registered just before the event, there is almost certainly a connection to the Shroud. Could this be the change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]?

texts.zh: “虚境变得安静了下来。再一次，疲倦的时间之河退回到了它陈腐的航道中。预知仪式昭告的改变已经成为了过去。现在带着敬畏离开，因为你已经映射了虚境的造业。”
texts.en: "The Shroud grows quiet. Once more, the weary river of time recedes into its well-worn course. The changes foretold by the rite of divination have come to pass. Go now in awe as you reflect on the workings of the Shroud."

note.zh: 预言已应验，局势结束。
note.en: The foretold change has happened; the situation ends.

texts.zh: 时间之流泥泞不堪，无法穿透。不幸的是，预知仪式没能穿过虚境的帷幕。根据相关约定，在扣除一小部分辛劳费时候，我们会返还一部分花费。
texts.en: The currents of time are muddied, impenetrable. Unfortunately, the rite of Divination has failed to pierce the veil of the Shroud. Accordingly, we will return a portion of the cost, minus a small tithe for our efforts.

note.zh: 整个征兆期间没有预言发生，城邦以能量补偿。
note.en: No prophecy occurred during the sign; the enclave pays energy instead.

texts.zh: 这是虚境的意志，你们的世界将被拜访。这些外来者是否会带来坏消息仍是个有待探索的奥秘。
texts.en: It is the will of the Shroud that your worlds be visited. Whether these strangers bring ill tidings or not is a mystery yet to be experienced.

sections.zh: 我们亲自找出这些来访者，拥抱虚境的意志
sections.en: We embrace the Shroud's will by seeking out these visitors ourselves

sections.zh: 我们拒绝来访者进入我们的领地，违背虚境的意志
sections.en: We defy the Shroud's will by denying visitors access to our territory

texts.zh: 一位[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡者来到了[Root.GetName]。由于信奉异端思想，这位“极端主义者”从城邦中被流放了出来，结果没有在任何到来的船只上登记显现。它直接出现在殖民地大型城市的中央广场，就好像空气突然物质化了一样，然后公开地宣告自己的信条能让它同虚境建立个人通讯。根据这个流亡者的说法，我们的人民可以通过共享梦境实现一种赐福状态。报告指出，殖民地里有很多人都听信了这个说法。
texts.en: An exile from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived on [Root.GetName]. Recently expelled from the Enclave for harbouring heretical views, this 'extremist' was not listed on the manifest of any incoming vessel. As if materializing out of the air, they appeared in the central square of the colony's largest city, publicly proclaiming a doctrine of personal communion with the Shroud. According to the exile, it is possible for our people to achieve a state of bliss akin to communal dreaming. Reports suggest that many in the colony are listening.

label.zh: 极端主义者在这里没有一席之地。把这个流亡者弄走。
label.en: Extremists have no place here. Remove the exile.

label.zh: 对拜访视而不见是不明智的。好好盯着这个流亡者。
label.en: Ignoring a visitation is unwise. Keep an eye on this exile.

label.zh: 以宾客的规格欢迎这位流亡者。
label.en: Welcome the exile as a guest.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of your planet appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现预言城邦的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the divining enclave appears here.

texts.zh: 尽管我们做了最大的努力，在[Root.GetName]上行动的那个[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]流亡分子依然在躲避着我们。或许是拥有什么先天的灵能能力，它总是可以在我们的安保部队到达之前进行预判。除此之外，流亡者的布道还在吸引大量的群众。许多殖民者都放弃工作，以响应这个所谓的萨满所拥护的洗礼和冥想实践。
texts.en: Despite our best efforts, the exiled member of the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] operating on [Root.GetName] continues to elude us. Perhaps due to some innate psionic ability, they have consistently been able to predict the arrival of our security forces. What's more, the exile's sermons continue to draw large crowds. Many colonists have begun to abandon their work in favor of the various ablutions and meditative practices espoused by this so-called shaman.

label.zh: 必须想办法阻止这个流亡者。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of your planet appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个城邦的名称。

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的安保部队成功地消灭了那个流亡的萨满。这个流放者前信徒中的一名——一位没能实现应许的梦境状态而逐渐心生不满的殖民者——向我们提供了必要的情报。普罗大众似乎接受了现实，然而，一小撮顽固分子似乎仍然抱守着萨满的教义。到目前为止，对这个殖民地增添安保人员似乎是有道理的，这样可以让人们对这位“殉道者”的尊敬逐渐消散褪去。
texts.en: Security forces on [Root.GetName] have successfully eliminated the rogue shaman. One of the exile's former adherents - a colonist who has grown increasingly disaffected by their failure to achieve the promised dream state - has provided us with the necessary intel. While the general populace appears to have accepted reality, an obstinate few remain dedicated to the shaman's teachings. For now, an increased security presence on the colony seems advisable, lest the veneration of this 'martyr' continue to fester.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of your planet appears here.

texts.zh: 流亡萨满的教义继续在[Root.GetName]上的人群内传播。这种激进的教条是某种能够让个人同虚境沟通的宗派，其践行者宣称能够实现一种改变意识的状态。我们收到许多报告，称极乐与康宁的感觉有所提升。其中一些人甚至宣称，通过某种共享的、梦境一般的状态，他们能够使用灵能同其他人沟通。不幸的是，这些“真信者”引发了一波创纪录的离职潮。生产力受到了很大的打击。
texts.en: The teachings of the exiled shaman on [Root.GetName] continue to spread throughout the populace. This radical doctrine is one of personal communion with the Shroud, and its practitioners claim to have achieved an altered state of consciousness. We are receiving reports of increased feelings of euphoria and well-being. Some individuals even claim they are now able to psionically communicate with one another through a shared, dreamlike state. Unfortunately, these 'true believers' are also leaving their jobs in record numbers. Productivity has taken a hit.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的星球的名字。

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了惊人的新闻：那个流亡萨满宣称自己的业绩已经完成，明显已经离开了殖民地。报告很零散，且并不明确，但所有报告都同意一点，即在带领信徒进行了最后一次冥想之后，这位萨满就那样从殖民地的中心广场凭空消失了。对于那些信徒来说，这就是萨满“飞升”进入虚境的证据。
texts.en: Startling news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: proclaiming their work done, the exiled shaman has apparently left the colony. Reports are scattered and inconclusive, but they all agree that after leading their followers in a final meditation, the shaman simply vanished from the colony's central square. To their followers, this is evidence of the shaman's 'ascension' into the Shroud.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of your planet appears here.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的事态有了奇怪的进展：在那个流亡萨满进行了所谓的“飞升”之后，我们的殖民者报告他们经历了一种意识的转换状态。这些人继续遵从萨满所推崇的仪式，现在已经能够进入一种灵能交流的状态。这种状态在殖民者间涌现出极大的欢愉和宁和，产生了深远的影响。
texts.en: Strange developments on [Root.GetName]: after the so-called 'ascension' of the exiled shaman, our colonists are reporting the experience of an altered state of consciousness. Continuing to follow the practices espoused by the shaman, these individuals are able to enter a state of psionic communion. The outpouring of joy and well-being this has produced amongst the colonists is profound.

texts.zh:
一艘载满了来自[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡侍僧的运输船同我们进行了联络。他们称自己为“变革派”，要求在我们的某颗星球上进行难民庇护。

这一事件意味着虚境行者内部发生了前所未有的大分裂。看来，太空城邦也没有我们想象中的那么团结。
texts.en:
We have been contacted by a transport ship carrying a number of exiled acolytes from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Calling themselves 'Reformers', they are requesting refuge on one of our worlds.

This represents an unprecedented schism within the Shroudwalkers. It would appear the Enclave is not as united as we were led to believe.

label.en: Xenos have no place inside our borders.

texts.zh: “虚境惊诧。我们收到消息，听说我们的一些前侍僧已经作为难民在你的星球安顿下来。这一作为让我们极其不悦，但就这样吧。鲁莽的行动一般都会导致绝望的后果。但是要记住这点：这些改革派不过是一群坑蒙拐骗之徒，一群无知的蠢蛋，以为自己掌握着破解虚境秘密的钥匙。庇护这群异端会让你冒风险。那些居住在虚境里的存在肯定会注意到这件事。”
texts.en: "The Shroud trembles. Word has reached us that some our former acolytes have taken refuge on one of your worlds. This has displeased us greatly, but so be it. Reckless action often leads to desperate results. Know this: these Reformers are nothing more than charlatans, vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Shroud. Shelter such heretics at your peril. Those that dwell within the Shroud have surely taken notice."

texts.zh: “虚境惊诧。我们已经收到消息，你拒绝了我们的前侍僧在你的国境内寻求庇护的请求。你做的很明智。这些‘改革派’不过是一群坑蒙拐骗之徒；一群无知的蠢蛋，以为自己掌握着破解虚境秘密的钥匙。任何决定庇护这群异端的团体都会冒风险。就让他们在太空中飘荡吧，无家可归，无心无肺，永远被此世和彼世遗忘。”
texts.en: "The Shroud shivers. Word has reached us that you have denied our former acolytes refuge within your borders. You are wise. These 'Reformers' are nothing more than charlatans; vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of the Shroud. Any who choose to shelter such heretics do so at their peril. Let them wander the void, homeless, hearthless, forever forsaken in this world and the next."

texts.zh:
“我们的恩主！在其他那么多世界置我们生死于不顾的时候，是你为我们提供了庇护……虚境一定会保佑你的，不论是此世还是彼世。我们的前同胞，[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]被传统遮蔽了双眼。虚境并非是不可渗透的。它存在一扇门，而我们发现了它的钥匙。

为了报答你的慷慨，我们愿意同你分享这个秘密。我们唯一要求的就是开工建设所需要的物资。”
texts.en:
"Our benefactors! That you have sheltered us, when so many others would have turned their backs... Surely the Shroud will bless you, both in this life and in that which lies Beyond. Our former brethren, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], are blinded by tradition. The Shroud is not impermeable. There is a Door, and we have discovered its Key.

In reward for your generosity, we would share these secrets with you. All we require are the resources with which to begin construction."

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现预言城邦的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the divining enclave appears here.

texts.zh:
“虚境惊诧！有了贵方的帮助，我们最终完成了大钥匙的建设。现在，我们最有天赋的同胞聚集在一起准备将其打开。随着他们的意识同钥匙连接在一起，他们的灵能能力得到了强化。此刻，这些勇敢的朝圣者进入了一个共享类梦境状态。当他们苏醒的时候，一扇前往虚境的大门就会打开。

愿那些居住的虚境中的存在为他们的努力赐福。”
texts.en:
"The Shroud shivers! With your help, we have at last completed construction of the Great Key. Even now, our most gifted brethren have gathered to begin the Opening. With their minds tethered to the Key, their psionic abilities have been amplified. Now, these brave pilgrims enter a shared dreamlike state. At their awakening, a Door to the Shroud will open.

May those that dwell within the Shroud bless their efforts."

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了令人难以置信的好消息：改革派们从长达数月的出神状态中苏醒了过来，现在已经成功地打开了一扇通往虚境的大门。一道靓丽的时空裂缝出现在了殖民地的中心城市上方。现在，某种类似强风的存在涌了出来，奶白色的亮光将天空渲染得五颜六色。刮过殖民地的灵能共振透过了改革派和殖民者的心以及意识。许多人相信这是[Root.GetName]“黄金时代”的黎明。
texts.en: Incredible news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A brilliant rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a great wind is issuing forth, iridescent with milky light. The psionic resonance that has blown through the colony has permeated the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many believe that this is the dawn a new 'golden age' on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了灾难般的坏消息：改革派们从长达数月的出神状态中苏醒了过来，现在已经成功地打开了一扇通往虚境的大门。一道破败的时空裂缝出现在了殖民地的中心城市上方。现在，某种类似纱雾的存在涌了出来，邪恶的亮光将天空渲染得十分瘆人。刮过殖民地的灵能瘴气扭曲了改革派和殖民者的心以及意识。许多人相信这是[Root.GetName]“黑暗时代”的开端。
texts.en: Disastrous news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A ragged rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a sickly fog is issuing forth, lurid with vile light. The psionic miasma that has permeated the colony has twisted the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many view this as the beginning of a new 'dark age' on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 令人担忧的消息自我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来：尽管缺乏资源，某些狂热的改革分子依然试图自己锻造了钥匙。他们使用临时替代装置增强自己的灵能能力，进入了共享类梦境状态。这一举动造成了殖民地中心城市的上方出现了一个时空裂口。有毒的、诱发焦虑的烟气瞬间灌了出来，看上去是来自虚境本身。许多人将这一现象称之为“虚境恶臭”，并且我们被告知这样的体验并不愉悦。[Root.GetName]的民心普遍的降低了。
texts.en: Disturbing news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: despite the lack of resources, some of the more zealous Reformers attempted to fashion a Key themselves. By amplifying their psionic abilities with the makeshift device, they entered into a shared dreamlike state. This precipitated a breach in the fabric of spacetime above the colony's central city. Noxious, anxiety-inducing fumes are issuing forth, presumably from the Shroud itself. Many are calling this phenomenon 'Shroud Stench', and we are told the experience is far from pleasant. Morale on [Root.GetName] is at an all-time low.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]传来了难以置信的新闻：今天早晨，某个宣称[hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself]是传奇英雄[hero_redivivus.GetName]的个体来到了首都的大广场。目击者们说感到了一股出于敬畏的沉默，强大的冷静和宁和之感席卷了聚集起来的民众。尽管[hero_redivivus.GetName]在历史上人尽皆知，是一名伟大的雄辩家和充满激情的领袖，这名可疑的个体用单调的、几乎没有感情的腔调，诉说着自己在“死后世界”遇到的经历。此人宣称自己的返回并不是为了领导，而是为了抹除我们对死亡的恐惧。
texts.en: Incredible news from [Root.GetName]: early this morning, an individual proclaiming [hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself] to be the legendary hero [hero_redivivus.GetName] entered the great square of the capital. Witnesses describe scenes of awed silence, as powerful feelings of calm and wellbeing radiated throughout the gathering crowd. While [hero_redivivus.GetName] was known to history as a great orator and impassioned leader, the individual in question spoke of their supposed experience 'in the afterworld' in a simple, almost lighthearted tone. They claim to have returned not to lead, but to erase our fear of death.

texts.zh: 某个宣称自己是一名传奇英雄的个体来到了我们的母星。这样的暴论有可能是真的吗？
texts.en: An individual claiming to be a legendary hero has appeared on our homeworld. Could their wild assertions possibly be true?

texts.zh:
对那名宣称自己是[hero_redivivus.GetName]的个体进行的调查有了结论。一开始我们的研究者们保持了可以理解的怀疑态度，然而这名个体不仅展现出了对伟大英雄所在时代和当地文化的极其详尽的知识，DNA分析也确认此人和伟大英雄的数个已知后代存在基因上的联系。

不仅如此，对[hero_redivivus.GetName]脑电波图样的更深层研究表明，其大脑存在独特的灵能残留。看上去，与其说是“从死亡重返人间”，[hero_redivivus.GetName]更像是以某种方式被传送到了一个类似于虚境的位面。[hero_redivivus.GetHisHerCap]对自己的“来世”经历显然很满意，[hero_redivivus.GetHisHer]现在安顿在首都郊区一处很安静的地方，并向愿意听从此人的群众布道，传播和平与无惧的信条。
texts.en:
The investigation into the individual claiming to be [hero_redivivus.GetName] has concluded. At first our researchers were understandably skeptical, but not only did the subject possess incredibly detailed knowledge of the great hero's time period and culture, DNA analysis confirms a genetic link to several known descendants.

Moreover, closer study of [hero_redivivus.GetName]'s' brainwave pattern revealed a distinct psionic residue. It seems likely that far from being 'returned from death', [hero_redivivus.GetName] was in some way transported to a realm akin the Shroud. [hero_redivivus.GetHisHerCap] experience of this 'afterlife' was apparently a contented one, and [hero_redivivus.GetHisHer] has now settled into a quiet existence on the outskirts of the capital, preaching a doctrine of fearlessness and peace to any who will listen.

texts.zh: 传感器探测到了数艘运输舰船的接近。这些舰船磨损严重、破败不堪，看上去就像是用废旧零件拼接在一起的一样。船队旗舰的指挥官向我们发送了招呼，但基于他们当前科技的状况，恐怕只能进行语音通讯。
texts.en: Sensors detect the approach of several transport vessels. Battered and broken-down, the ships appear cobbled together from spare parts. The commander of the caravan's flagship is hailing us, but given the state of their technology, any communication is likely to be audio only.

texts.zh: 愿神赐福于你。我是这支船队的受命领袖。我们请求允许安全地通过你的宇域，并希望能够获得一些捐赠的食物。我们正在朝圣的路途中，在经年累月的太空生活之后，我的人民们变得十分孱弱。
texts.en: Divine blessings upon you. I am the anointed leader of this caravan. We ask for safe passage through your space, and a kind donation of food. We are on pilgrimage, and after long years in the void, my people grow thin.

label.zh: 我们必须尽可能地向他们提供帮助。
label.en: We will provide what aid we can.

label.zh: 你们可以通过，但我们匀不出食物。
label.en: You may pass, but we cannot spare the food.

texts.zh:
我的人民得以果腹，在此衷心感谢。事实上，我们到达此地绝非意外。数代人之前，一位强大的先知指明了一颗天国的星辰，说我们可以在那里触摸神明。这颗星辰属于你。

就是此地，我们自感官世界迈向祝圣之国度仅有一步之遥，但我们的船只很老旧，我们的科技还十分落后。要想同祝圣之国度进行接触，我们需要你的帮助。你不必相信我们的神明，但难道你会拒绝这个让我们接触神明的机会吗？求你了，给我们所需的资源，我们就能完成这场朝圣。
texts.en:
From my people, the gratitude of full bellies. In truth, our arrival here is no accident. Generations past, a powerful seer pointed to a star in the heavens and said that there we would reach the divine. Yours is that star.

Here, the border between the world of the senses and the Blessed Realm is thin, but our ships are old, and our technology second-rate. To make contact with the Blessed Realm we will need your help. You may not share our gods, but will you deny us the chance to meet them? Please, grant us the resources we need to complete our pilgrimage.

texts.zh:
那真是……美轮美奂。

代表所有朝圣者，我衷心地感谢你。我不是诗人。我无法将经历凝练成语言。但是多亏了你的慷慨施舍，我们触碰了神明。希望祝圣之国度的永恒荣光能够加诸你身。
texts.en:
It was... Brilliant.

On behalf of all pilgrims, I thank you. I am no poet. I cannot put the experience into words. But thanks to your generosity, we have touched the divine. May the eternal glory of the Blessed Realm be upon you.

texts.zh:
那支曾乞求我们提供援助的朝圣者船队结局十分惨烈。重构的遥测信号显示，他们进行了某种形式的实验，很有可能跟灵能有关。由于一次能量激增，他们旗舰引擎核心的遏止立场发生了破裂。接踵而至的爆炸摧毁了整个船队，并在[wayward_pilgrims_system.GetName]恒星系释放了一场威力强大的灵能风暴。所有预估都表明，此等规模的风暴需要数年才能消散。

不管这群神棍打算在这里做什么，很显然他们失败了，而我们还得在这里帮他们擦屁股。
texts.en:
The caravan of pilgrims who came to us begging for aid has met a grisly end. Reconstructive telemetry indicates they were engaged in some form of experiment, possibly psionic in nature. Due to a sudden spike in energy, the containment field around their flagship's engine core was breached. The resulting explosion destroyed the caravan, and has unleashed a potent Psionic Storm in the [wayward_pilgrims_system.GetName] system. Every estimate shows it will take several years before a storm of this size can dissipate.

Whatever these holy fools aimed to do here, they obviously failed, and we have been left to deal with the fallout.

# 预知 / Divination（虚境行者的占卜仪式 The Shroudwalkers' rite）

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · DLC：霸主 Overlord
- 来源 Sources：events/overlord_enclaves_events.txt:7380（enclave.415）, :7585（enclave.4100）, :7397（enclave.416）, :8064–12157（预言事件 prophecies enclave.5000–5576）, :7627/:7677（4150/4151）; common/situations/01_overlord_situations.txt:5, :116; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:4932–4958; common/special_projects/00_projects_overlord.txt
- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12（C6）

## 如何开始 How it starts
在“虚境行者城邦”菜单询问“我们的命运将会如何？”并付费（enclave.410.b，同一时间只能进行一次占卜，且有冷却）后，“预知仪式开始”（enclave.415）。
After asking the Shroudwalkers about our fate and paying (enclave.410.b; one divination at a time, with a cooldown), "the rite of divination has begun" (enclave.415).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline
1. 10天后（enclave.4100）以5:5随机开启两种征兆之一（互斥）；20年内出现过的征兆权重×0.2。
   10 days later one of two signs starts at 5:5; a sign seen in the last 20 years has weight ×0.2.
   - 轨迹的征兆 Sign of the Locus：空间本身发生异变。
   - 来访者的征兆 Sign of the Visitor：有来客造访我们的世界。
2. 征兆是一个局势（基础每月+2，外交姿态等可±2）。每月以10（无事）:1:1…从九则预言中抽取；每则预言有自己的前置（一次性标记、进度门槛、人口等），先通过的一则会设置“已发生”，因此一次征兆至多应验一则。进度达90%仍无预言时，每月强制从同组中抽一。
   Each sign is a situation (base +2/month, ±2 from diplomatic stance etc.). Monthly it draws 10 (nothing) : 1 : 1 … among nine prophecies; each has its own gate, and the first that fires marks the sign as fulfilled, so at most one prophecy per sign. From 90% progress one is forced each month.
3. 局势完成：若有预言应验则“征兆消退”（416），否则“不透明的帷幕”（5557，退还1000能量）。两者互斥。
   On completion: "The Sign Fades" (416) if a prophecy happened, otherwise "Opaque Veil" (5557, 1000 energy back).
